quizName: DMV Practice Test #5 20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: A proper lane position can help you do all of the following, except:

options.text: Increase your ability to see and be seen.

questions.explanation: Your lane position helps with safety. It helps you see and be seen by others. It helps you avoid blind spots and prepares you for turns. It does not help you go faster.

questions.question: If your motorcycle weaves while riding over rain grooves or bridge gratings, you should:

options.text: Relax, maintain a steady speed, and ride straight across the surface.
Tighten your grip on the handle grips and speed up to get past the hazard.
Ride on the shoulder instead of on the grooves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Relax, maintain a steady speed, and ride straight across the surface.
questions.explanation: Weaving over rain grooves or bridge gratings is usually not dangerous. Stay calm and ride straight across at a steady speed. Zigzagging to stop the weaving is more dangerous than riding straight.

questions.question: One way to tell if your rear tire is flat while riding is:

options.text: There is a hissing noise from the rear of the bike.
The back end jerks from side to side.
The rear brake does not work.

questions.correctAnswerText: The back end jerks from side to side.
questions.explanation: If your rear tire fails, the back of your motorcycle will jerk side to side. You usually won't hear the tire fail.

questions.question: A person with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of ______ or higher is considered legally intoxicated.
questions.explanation: If you are 21 or older and your BAC is 0.08 percent or higher, you are legally intoxicated. It is illegal and dangerous to drive any vehicle while intoxicated.

questions.question: If your motorcycle weaves while riding over rain grooves or bridge gratings, you should:

options.text: Relax, maintain a steady speed, and ride straight across the grooves.
Move to the leftmost portion of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Relax, maintain a steady speed, and ride straight across the grooves.
questions.explanation: Your motorcycle may weave over rain grooves or bridge gratings, but this is usually not dangerous. Stay calm and ride straight ahead at a steady speed. Zigzagging makes the problem worse.

questions.question: Where is there the greatest risk of conflict between a motorcycle and other traffic?
questions.explanation: The greatest risk of conflict between motorcycles and other traffic is at intersections. Stay alert at intersections where another vehicle might cross your path.

questions.question: If you are carrying a passenger, they should:

options.text: Sit as far back as possible.

questions.explanation: Your passenger should lean with you during turns and curves. They should sit forward, not backward, and hold onto passenger handholds or your waist, hips, or belt.

questions.question: Which type of sign is yellow with black lettering or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards and conditions.

questions.question: If your front tire goes flat while riding:

options.text: There will be no change in steering.
The ride will feel too smooth.

questions.explanation: If your front tire fails, the steering will feel heavy. If steering feels heavy, pull off the road right away and check your tires.

questions.question: The front brake should:

options.text: Only be used by experienced operators.
Be used together with the rear brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be used together with the rear brake.
questions.explanation: Use both the front and rear brakes together every time you slow down or stop.

questions.question: A DOT-compliant helmet has all of the following, except:

options.text: Bright colors painted on the outside.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bright colors painted on the outside.
questions.explanation: A DOT-compliant helmet must have an impact-resistant outer shell, an impact-absorbing inner liner, a comfort liner, and a chinstrap retention system.

questions.question: You should increase your following distance if:

options.text: You can see through the vehicle ahead of you.

questions.explanation: Increase your following distance if the pavement is slippery, if you cannot see through the vehicle ahead, or if traffic is heavy. You need more space to stop safely.

questions.question: When an operator's left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the operator:
questions.explanation: Hand signals show turns or stops when mechanical turn signals are not used. Left arm extended straight out means the operator plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: Your lane position should:

options.text: Avoid other road users' blind spots.
Provide a good view of the shoulder.
Provide a poor view of road hazards.
Invite others to share your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid other road users' blind spots.
questions.explanation: Choose your lane position so you can see other drivers and they can see you. Do not stay in another driver's blind spot for long periods.

questions.question: A wobble, or shaking of the front wheel and handlebars, may be caused by:

options.text: Brakes that are not working properly.

questions.explanation: Most wobbles are caused by improper loading, unsuitable accessories, or incorrect tire pressure.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a safe step in preventing fatigue while riding?

options.text: Limiting the distance ridden in one day

questions.explanation: On long trips, take frequent breaks to rest and limit riding to six hours per day. Dress to protect yourself from wind, cold, and rain. Do not use artificial stimulants, as they can be dangerous when they wear off.

questions.question: A face shield:

options.text: Provides protection for the eyes and face.
Does not protect the face as well as goggles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Provides protection for the eyes and face.
questions.explanation: A plastic, impact-resistant face shield protects the eyes and face best. Eyeglasses or sunglasses are not good enough. In Vermont, you do not need eye or face protection if your motorcycle has a windshield, but it is recommended.

questions.question: When approaching a blind intersection with a stop sign, riders should:

options.text: Stop at the stop sign then proceed through the intersection.
Ignore the stop sign and move forward to get a better look.
Stop at the stop sign before moving forward to improve their view of cross traffic.
Proceed through the intersection without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop at the stop sign before moving forward to improve their view of cross traffic.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection with a stop sign, stop where indicated. Then move forward slowly and stop again just before the cross traffic lane. Lean your body forward and look around buildings, parked cars, or bushes. Keep your front wheel out of the crossroad while you are looking.

questions.question: When should your rearview mirror be adjusted?
questions.explanation: Clean and adjust both mirrors before starting your motorcycle. Adjust them so you can see the lane behind you and as much as possible of the lane next to you.

questions.question: Once a motorcycle helmet has been involved in a crash, it should be:
questions.explanation: Replace any helmet that has been worn in a crash.
